Content Incrementality (Individual Titles)

Events Sep 15–21 2026 · 7-day post window · Organic Discovery · US · movies and series pooled (every program ≥ 10,000 TVT hrs that week). Content type and genre (primary_genre_cms) come from dsac_program_info.

Discovery Incr TVT = Σsegments (net Δ/viewer × full-US segment viewers × de-dup weight); Discovery Incrementality Rate (DIR) = Discovery Incr TVT ÷ actual title TVT (Sep 15–21) — the only rate; there is no additive-proportional rate. Search + Deeplink TVT is the title's actual Sep 15–21 viewing from sessions started on the Search page or from an external deeplink — the sessions the organic-discovery estimate excludes — and is counted as fully incremental; Total Incr TVT = Discovery Incr TVT + Search + Deeplink TVT. Net Δ/viewer is the matched treated−control post-window view time, on-title + off-title, winsorized. The weight is the per-(title × segment) pre-TVT de-dup weight (Step 9 §4); * = pooled segment fallback. Cells with n_pairs < 100 are thin; < 30 are not published. Methodology: v10e_weight_methodology.html.

Single Title Summary

Mean trajectory of matched treatment vs control viewers. Day 0 = first 24h after the viewer's event (treatment: exact event moment; control: midnight of the event date). Pre-period overlap shows matching quality; post-period divergence shows incrementality. Pre/Post averages use 7 days each. Band = ±1 SE.

Left: what control viewers watch instead (substitution). Right: what treatment viewers watch after the event (amplification); the treatment title is highlighted in orange. Both deltas share one denominator — control off-title viewing per viewer. Delta (on + off title) = (treatment on + off − control off) ÷ control off: net incrementality including the title's own viewing. Off-title Delta = (treatment off − control off) ÷ control off: substitution only. Scope: the cards use total full-catalog viewing per viewer for the selected segment; the bars show only each arm's top 30 alt-titles, so bar sums are smaller than the card totals.
